set -eu
i=0

  state=$(systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null || true)
  [ "$state" = running ] && break
  i=$((i + 1))
  sleep 1
done
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'uptime_seconds='; cut -d. -f1 /proc/uptime
printf 'system_state=%s\n' "$state"
printf 'kernel='; uname -r
printf 'os='; . /etc/os-release; printf '%s %s\n' "$ID" "$VERSION_ID"
stat -c 'drop mode=%a symbolic=%A user=%U group=%G filesystem_mount=%m' /srv/drop
findmnt -n -o TARGET,SOURCE,FSTYPE,OPTIONS -T /srv/drop
stat -c 'retained path=%n owner_uid=%u mode=%a size=%s' /srv/drop/owner-file

rm -f /srv/drop/post-reboot-writer
setpriv --reuid=65533 --regid=65533 --clear-groups sh -c 'printf post-reboot > /srv/drop/post-reboot-writer && rm /srv/drop/post-reboot-writer'
if setpriv --reuid=65533 --regid=65533 --clear-groups rm /srv/drop/owner-file 2>/tmp/post-reboot-rm-error; then
  printf '%s\n' 'FAIL: cross-user removal succeeded after reboot'
  exit 1
else
  cat /tmp/post-reboot-rm-error
  printf '%s\n' 'PASS: shared writes work and cross-user removal remains denied after reboot'
fi
rm -f /tmp/post-reboot-rm-error
